challenges.title: Parse Output Redirection Operator
challenges.description: A shell must separate redirection tokens from standard command arguments before passing execution parameters to exec. Implement a parser helper in this language.
challenges.task: Write a Function that takes a slice of command tokens, detects if '>' is present, and returns the cleaned command arguments along with the target filename if specified.
hints: Iterate through the token slice looking for '>' or '1>' characters.
When found, the next token in the slice is typically the target file name.

challenges.title: Configuring File Redirection for Commands
challenges.description: Before running a command with output redirection, the shell must open the target file and hook it up to standard output.
challenges.task: Implement a Go snippet using os.OpenFile to open a destination file for writing with truncation and creation flags, and assign it to os.Stdout.
hints: Assign the resulting file descriptor or use syscall.Dup2 to map it to standard output.
